sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Healthcare stand out as the market's only all-green pillars, with Energy demonstrating sustained multi-month leadership while defensives show early cracks.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated, with only 2 of 11 sectors exhibiting positive returns across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD). Energy holds the top spot across the board with a momentum score of 0.917 (or 0.92), backed by Healthcare (momentum 0.850, rank 3), which also advanced one spot over the past five sessions. Technology maintains solid positioning at rank 2 with a 0.750 momentum score, though its rank remained flat.

Meanwhile, rotation is muted with low-momentum sectors like Consumer Cyclical (momentum 0.333, rank 10) and Real Estate (momentum 0.400, rank 7) inching up just +1 spot. At the bottom, Communication Services remains completely exhausted at rank 11 with a 0.000 momentum score, falling another spot alongside Financials (momentum 0.417, rank 8) and Consumer Defensive.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors are all-green across all evaluated time horizons: Energy (0.92 momentum) and Healthcare (0.85 momentum).
- **Sustained Dominance:** Energy is the sole sector demonstrating sustained strength, remaining in the top 3 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month rank windows while holding rank 1 YTD (0.917 momentum).
- **High Momentum Cluster:** Technology retains strong overall momentum at 0.750 (rank 2 YTD), trailing only Energy (0.917) and Healthcare (0.850).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Five-Day Gainers:** Healthcare advanced +1 spot to rank 3 (momentum 0.85), joined by Consumer Cyclical (+1 spot to rank 10, momentum 0.33) and Real Estate (+1 spot to rank 7, momentum 0.40).
- **Five-Day Losers:** Communication Services slipped -1 spot to bottom-tier rank 11 (momentum 0.00), Financials fell -1 spot to rank 8 (momentum 0.42), and Consumer Defensive dropped -1 spot to rank 4 (momentum 0.60).
- **Deep Laggards:** Communication Services (0.000 momentum), Utilities (0.300 momentum, rank 9), and Consumer Cyclical (0.333 momentum, rank 10) anchor the weakest segment of the market.

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Consumer Defensive exhibits a classic early-warning divergence, slipping -1 spot over the last 5 days despite holding an above-average 0.60 momentum score and rank 4 YTD.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and healthcare maintain broad, sustained momentum leadership, while sharp 5-day rotations favor industrial cyclicals over defensive staples and utilities.

Market strength remains anchored in traditional value and defensive leadership. Oil & Gas Integrated and Drug Manufacturers - General continue to dominate the upper deciles, reinforced by 23 of 144 groups holding all-green profiles across all timeframes. Energy dominates the absolute momentum tier, led by Oil & Gas Drilling (0.858), Oil & Gas E&P (0.853), and Oil & Gas Integrated (0.848).

Simultaneously, a distinct rotation is unfolding under the surface: capital is surging into industrials, led by Engineering & Construction (+30 spots to rank 50) and Electronic Components (+27 spots to rank 29). This is funded by sharp pullbacks in consumer staples and rate-sensitive defensive pockets, with Utilities - Regulated Water plunging 33 spots and Internet Content & Information deteriorating further into the market's basement.

## Strength
- **Broad-based leaders:** 23 of 144 groups are all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD periods, led by REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.88), Diagnostics & Research (0.86), and Oil & Gas E&P (0.85).
- **Sustained institutional leadership:** Oil & Gas Integrated, Drug Manufacturers - General, Tobacco, Medical Care Facilities, and Medical Distribution have all preserved top-36 positioning across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Top momentum tiers:** REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.882, rank 8 YTD) and Diagnostics & Research (0.865, rank 24 YTD) lead all industries, closely followed by the broader energy complex.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Fastest short-term gainers:** Engineering & Construction jumped 30 spots (rank 50, momentum 0.40), Electronic Components climbed 27 spots (rank 29, momentum 0.53), and REIT - Specialty advanced 22 spots (rank 47, momentum 0.62).
- **Steepest decliners:** Utilities - Regulated Water plunged 33 spots to rank 73 (momentum 0.38), Internet Content & Information dropped 26 spots to rank 115 (momentum 0.12), and Beverages - Brewers shed 23 spots to rank 41 (momentum 0.45).
- **Momentum laggards:** Advertising Agencies holds the absolute bottom score at 0.054 (rank 144 YTD), alongside Internet Content & Information (0.115), Gambling (0.121, rank 143 YTD), and Solar (0.134, rank 141 YTD).

## Divergences
- **Fading strength:** Despite solid momentum, five-day rank deterioration is surfacing in Insurance - Reinsurance (-9 spots, momentum 0.70), Medical Distribution (-7 spots, momentum 0.71), Department Stores (-12 spots, momentum 0.65), and Healthcare Plans (-12 spots, momentum 0.62).
- **Emerging turnarounds:** Rank is outrunning lagging momentum in Engineering & Construction (+30 spots, momentum 0.40), Specialty Industrial Machinery (+19 spots, momentum 0.50), and Aerospace & Defense (+10 spots, momentum 0.45).
- **Fragile profile:** Software - Infrastructure maintains all-green status across all timeframes, but shows severe internal rank instability with an agreement score of just 0.37.
